verdict: Lead cost improved sharply, but pipeline conversion and tracking need immediate attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 28 leads at a cost per lead of $155.45 — and in the most recent 7 days that cost dropped 42.4% week-over-week, a meaningful efficiency gain driven by Meta. However, conversion tracking is currently not recording accurately, so that cost-per-lead figure cannot be fully verified until the repair is complete. More urgently, 28 leads entered your pipeline this period and none have progressed to appointments or closed matters, which points to a gap in the intake process rather than an ads problem. We are addressing both the tracking repair and the pipeline flow as priorities heading into next period.

highlights.phrase: Cost per lead over the last 28 days, down 42% in the most recent week
Leads received this period, all from Meta campaigns
Actions taken on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, direction requests, and website clicks

watch_item.issue: 28 leads entered the pipeline this period with zero appointments and zero conversions recorded — the intake process is not moving leads forward, and conversion tracking is not capturing activity accurately.
watch_item.fix: Conversion tracking is being repaired so results reflect true performance; the intake and follow-up process is being reviewed to ensure leads are reached and progressed.
